description: Update a geofence. Only the fields provided change; null clears dwellSeconds, group or externalId. Set active to pause or resume it.

active.description: Paused geofences are not sent to apps and record nothing.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

cooldownSeconds.description: Ignore a repeat of the same transition by the same contact for this long, 300 to 604,800 seconds. Default 3,600.

dwellSeconds.description: Record app.geofence_dwelled after the contact stays this many seconds (60 to 14,400). null turns dwell off.

externalId.description: Your own ID for the place, unique per workspace; import_geofences matches rows by it. null removes it.

group.description: Optional group label (letters, numbers, spaces, . _ -), e.g. stores. Triggers and segments can target a whole group. null removes it.

radiusMeters.description: Radius in meters, 100 to 10,000. Phones trigger small regions late; 200 or more is recommended.

name: update_geofence

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_geofence` MCP tool.

geofence.description: The geofence record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
